study_note: Single-seed exploratory AMBI-XQC Humanoid Walk state run at seed 55 for one million agent decisions. TOLD uses recurrent three-step BPTT, while canonical action-local XQC uses J=2 rounds, N=32 rollouts per round, H=3 imagined steps, and G=4 updates per round. Ten online evaluation episodes run at step zero and every 100k decisions. This first full GPU execution screens throughput and learning behavior before any longer protocol; it is not a statistical or paper reproduction. W&B syncs online from node-local temporary storage; evaluations and portable best/latest checkpoints use the launcher's explicit durable result directory. Exact trainer resume is not supported.
